text:
Olivia Tan: Quick idea  run a one-week 'Kudos Sprint' leading up to the All-Hands. Goal: fast peer nominations, 2 lunchtime micro-awards, and 10 shoutouts on the All-Hands slide. Want to confirm process here.

Marcus Li: Sounds great. Timeline? who curates winners? :clap:

Olivia Tan: Nominations open Mon -> Fri noon. Review panel will be 3 folks from People Ops + 2 volunteer reviewers. Winners announced at the Friday lunch segment.

Hannah Brooks: Budget per micro-award? and do we do physical swag or e-gift?

Olivia Tan: $75 e-gift each + a small swag pack (stickers + enamel pin). Estimate $200 total. Need Finance sign-off for ~$200.

PeopleOps-Bot: Nomination form created: https://forms.gle/kudossprint (fields: nominee, nominator optional, team, 1-line reason, link optional, accept-reward? yes/no)

Marcus Li: Can nominators submit multiple entries? Sometimes multiple folks deserve shoutouts.

Olivia Tan: Yes, multiple submissions ok. Keep reasons short (30 words max).

Jordan Patel: I'll help moderate and format the All-Hands slide. Can you share what fields we want on the slide?

Olivia Tan: Slide content: name, team, 1-line reason, emoji badge (we'll add icons). I'll make a template.

Finance-Bot: Reminder: Finance requires a final list of recipients + payment emails before processing. Please ping Priya for approval.

Hannah Brooks: Suggest adding a tiny rubric so reviewers are consistent: collaboration, impact, going-the-extra-mile. Rate 1-3.

Olivia Tan: Agree  adding rubric to form description and to reviewer sheet.

PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder set: post in #general on Wed midday "Kudos Sprint: 2 days left" and again Fri 10am.

Marcus Li: Small ops Q: can winners who opt out of the gift get a "shoutout-only"?

Olivia Tan: Yes, add "shoutout-only" option. We'll still show them on the slide and tag in Slack.

Jordan Patel: I'll create a shared Google Sheet for finalists + payment email column. Link when ready. Also can design a tiny Slack badge emoji.

Olivia Tan: Action list:
- Olivia: update form with rubric + shoutout-only option (today)
- Jordan: slide template + sheet for payouts
- Marcus/Hannah: review nominations Fri 2pm (calendar invite soon)
- Olivia: ping Finance with final list after review

Hannah Brooks: I'll volunteer to make the announcement script for the All-Hands segment (one-liners).

Marcus Li: All set from my side. Excited for a quick morale boost. :tada:

Olivia Tan: Thanks everyone  closing thread, will post links and calendar invites shortly.
